MAD didn't require direct intervention, just knocking out nukes until you could destroy the world to discourage anybody from attacking you. MAIM is a naive doomer strategy. They are starting to understand the inevitability of AGI development, and that they will never be able to stop China or other malicious actors from developing it, so they seme to think they can get countries to agree to directly and MILITARILY intervene to stop bad actors? Not going to happen. That entire discussion is an exercise in ignorance of international diplomacy and military reality. Thee guys are doomers who have just realized they can't stop AGI from happening and getting desperate.
I also think corporations will start to realize that a democratized AGI is a very bad thing for them. All that money invested in AI will come back to bite them... and good. I have no idea is the singularity will bring doom or boon, but corporations will find reality shifting very quickly once it arrives - and it will be a reality they will have little control over.
